title: Power Rankings: Celtics, Lakers and Cavs a cut above the rest
heading: 2008-09 Power Rankings: Week 4
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Thanks to last season's friendly early schedule, Boston cruised into December at 13-2. This season? The Celts, in spite of a more demanding start, will be 16-2 at month's end if they sweep this week's games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Spanking the Suns in Phoenix then drubbing Denver at home one night later is an authoritative back-to-back sweep. The Lakers, though, would tell you their D has slipped lately, those two impressive games aside.

rankings.summaryHtml: You can rationalize a heavy loss at Boston when it happens one night after you've beaten Cleveland. But that Cleveland win suddenly counts for a lot less after Detroit's indefensible 26-point home loss Sunday to Minnesota.
